blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu — Mandaue City is pushing ahead with its proposed 2027 infrastructure programs, including revisions to the A.C. Cortes Avenue drainage project, to address flooding and improve sewerage and drainage systems. Four resolutions covering drainage, sewerage, public works, and investment planning were initially approved by the Mandaue City Development Council (CDC) during its regular meeting on October 1, 2026. The measures cover the Metropolitan Cebu Sewerage Master Plan, proposed Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) projects for Mandaue City in 2027, revisions to the A.C. Cortes Avenue drainage project, and the city’s proposed 2027 Annual Investment Program (AIP). […]... Keep on reading: Mandaue advances infrastructure plans, seeks drainage project revisions
